title: The coach's intake, recorded
desc: A recorded Claude Code session with a made-up athlete: /fitness-coach intake asks a safety screen, goals and a movement self-check, drafts the profile with the engine, and writes it on a yes.
window: Claude Code · a demo vault, a made-up athlete

say: Welcome. This is a fresh start: I won't look at any old logs or body data until the end, and then only if you choose to.
**Round 1: screening**
1. **Regular exercise.** In the last 3 months, have you done planned exercise at least 3 days a week, about 30 minutes each time, at moderate effort or harder?
2. **Known conditions.** Has a doctor ever told you that you have a heart condition, a metabolic condition (for example a blood-sugar condition) or a kidney condition?
3. **Warning signs.** In the last few months, have you had any of these? Pick all that apply, or say None. …
4. **The rest.** Do any of these apply? …
A short reply is fine, for example "1 yes, 2 no, 3 none, 4 none".
You're cleared to train normally (screening result: **Go**).
**Round 2: basics and goals**
2. **Age, height, morning weight, and your waist at the navel**, if you can measure it. …
3. **Which goals matter for the next 6 months?** Pick up to 3, and put them in order if you pick more than one: …

steps.user: Male. 34, 178 cm, 82 kg, waist 89 cm. Goals in order: 1 build strength, 2 build muscle, 3 posture and mobility capacity.

steps.note: ⋯ a wish for muscles to focus on (the coach decides the priorities after the assessment), then three more rounds: the week, equipment and history ⋯

say: **Movement self-check.** Type the results back in one reply. Stop any test that hurts and tell me which one it was.
3. **Hang and pull:** dead hang for as long as you can (seconds), then max strict pull-ups.
6. **Overhead reach:** back and head against a wall, arms straight up. Do your thumbs touch the wall without your lower back arching?
7. **Wall test:** heels, hips and shoulders on the wall. How big is the gap behind your head, in cm?

steps.user: I'll skip the photos for now. Self-check: 1 easy, heels down. 2: 22 push-ups. 3: 45 s hang, then 6 strict pull-ups. …

steps.note: ⋯ one more round: desk hours, sleep and supplements ⋯

say: Everything is drafted and the engine accepts it. Here's your profile before I write anything.
